job.title: Visual Merchandiser
job.description:
Join Our Floral Merchandising Team East Brisbane!

Are you passionate about creating beautiful spaces and bringing joy through flowers? We are partnered with Australia’s largest wholesaler of fresh flowers and potted products and are looking for dedicated and reliable individuals to join our dynamic merchandising field team East Brisbane.

About Us: Our floral merchandising team specializes in designing inviting floral and potted displays in major supermarkets across Australia. We take pride in our work, and we want you to be a part of our mission to brighten up every store we serve!

The Role: As a member of our floral merchandising team, you will enhance the shopping experience for customers by maintaining stunning floral displays in stores. Your areas of service will include Morningside, Mt Gravatt and Wynnum.

Key Details:

  • Work Schedule: 4 days/week – Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday (potential for additional days)
  • Hours: Approximately 24-30 hours per week

Responsibilities:

  • Merchandising our product range in major supermarket chains within your assigned area
  • Creating and maintaining beautiful point-of-sale displays
  • Monitoring stock levels and collaborating with store managers to ensure product availability
  • Transporting stock from the loading dock to the shop floor, unpacking, and creatively displaying (lifting up to 12kgs)
  • Ensuring the display area is clean and checking product quality
  • Engaging with customers and liaising with store and department managers

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive training provided
  • An opportunity to work in a creative, supportive team environment

Ideal Candidate: We invite applicants who possess the following skills and attributes:

  • A reliable car and a valid Australian driver’s license are essential
  • Retail, supermarket, or merchandising experience is a plus, but not mandatory
  • Exceptional customer service skills and strong communication abilities
  • A well-presented professional with a flair for creativity
  • Reliable, physically fit, and comfortable working independently

How to Apply: Interested candidates will be contacted via email and phone for screening and interviews. Please ensure your resume is updated with your current contact information.

Join us and make every shopping experience a little more beautiful!

job.title: FORKLIFT OPERATOR / GENERAL HAND – NIGHT SHIFT
job.description:
Ingleburn | $46.24 per hour | Regular night shifts

BLU is seeking an experienced and reliable Forklift Operator / General Hand to join our client, Australia’s leading wholesaler of fresh flowers and potted products, at their Ingleburn facility.

Working within a small night shift team, you’ll help keep warehouse operations running smoothly and prepare stock for the day shift. This is a hands-on role combining forklift operation with general warehouse and production support duties.

About the role

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Loading and unloading trucks using a forklift.
  • Processing returned stock and managing waste.
  • Checking delivery and dispatch schedules using a computer.
  • Moving and preparing stock for the day shift production team.
  • Maintaining a clean, organised and safe work area.
  • Working closely with your team to meet nightly operational requirements.

Shift times

  • Sunday: Midnight–6.00am
  • Monday to Thursday: 10.00pm–6.00am

Pay rate: $46.24 per hour for night shift.

About you

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • A current forklift licence and practical operating experience.
  • Previous experience in a warehouse or production environment.
  • Basic computer skills to check schedules and stock information.
  • A reliable approach to attendance and the ability to work the listed night shifts.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to safe work practices.
  • The ability to work efficiently, support teammates and assist with general warehouse duties.

Interested? Apply now with your current resume outlining your forklift and warehouse experience.

job.title: In Store Florist
job.description:
Our client, a market leader in wholesale floral and potted products, priding themselves on product quality and customer service are seeking to recruit Floral Wrappers/florists with previous experience or training to join our team on a casual basis 5-6 days per week.

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to work within a retail space who will ensure the highest quality customer service, floral ranges and flower arrangements are provided for the store’s customers. Recent graduates of floristry training encouraged to apply.

Located in Oxenford, duties will include:

  • Wrapping of mixed and single floral bunches (small and large)
  • Bouquet arrangements to customer specification
  • Use of specialised gift-wrapping materials
  • Advising customers on floral selections
  • Merchandising the store to showcase designs and quality
  • Maintaining stock levels
  • Maintaining a safe, clean, and well-organised working and shopping environment and comply with all applicable health and safety procedures and safe work practices.

To be successful, candidates will have the following:

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively unsupervised
  • Certificate 3 in Floristry or equivalent experience
  • Ability to follow instructions and procedures
  • Passion for floral retail
  • Creative flair
  • Effective time management skills
  • Strong work ethic
  • Ability to visually examine products for quality and freshness
  • Available to work shifts on Monday - Friday (potentially Saturdays), Start time approx. from 7:30am.
  • Expected hours roughly 30-35 hours/wk
  • Previous exposure to a retail environment would be advantageous

Applicants will be notified via email and phone if successful for interview selection. Please ensure your application has a current email address and mobile number.
